subtitle: Lightweight neko control center
detectingInstallation: Looking for a compatible neko runtime…
dashboardNoSecret: The dashboard has no access secret. Use it only on a trusted LAN.
proxyModeTip: Switch the neko runtime persona without restarting the service.
trafficModeTip: Select the transparent traffic-capture style used by the cat.
dnsModeTip: Switching to fake-ip disables incompatible China IPv4/IPv6 bypass rules.
restartAfterApply: A running service is restarted once to load the new configuration.
ipCheckTip: Check the router egress and local mixed proxy port public IPv4 addresses.
confirmStop: Stopping interrupts proxy connections for LAN clients. Continue?
confirmRestart: Proxy connections are briefly interrupted during restart. Continue?
confirmApplyRestart: Applying these modes restarts the running service. Continue?
invalidResponse: The server returned an invalid response
permissionMissing: Required plugin permissions are missing. Grant them in Framework Settings.
ipv6ProxyTip: Let the neko companion handle IPv6 traffic transparently.
quicProxyTip: When off, UDP 443/8443 is blocked to reduce QUIC bypass; when on, the proxy core may handle it.
devicePolicySummary: Choose which LAN devices use the proxy. This section is collapsed by default.
deviceModeTip: New unlisted devices follow this default; each known device can still be switched individually.
noDevices: No LAN devices found. You can add a MAC address manually.
devicePolicyTip: MAC matching is preferred. Saving restarts the service and briefly interrupts proxy connections.
ipFilterWarning: ShellCrash also has {count} IP/CIDR filter entries; they remain effective in addition to this list.
deviceAreaWarning: The current ShellCrash interception scope may not include ordinary LAN clients, so this device policy might not take effect.
invalidMac: Enter a valid unicast MAC address.
confirmDiscardDeviceChanges: Refreshing discards unsaved device changes. Continue?
emptyWhitelist: Select at least one proxy device when unlisted devices default to direct.
confirmDeviceRestart: Saving the device policy restarts the running service and briefly interrupts proxy connections. Continue?
uploadConfigTip: Routing YAML files up to 2 MiB are accepted and are not activated automatically.
importConfigTip: Only public HTTPS URLs are accepted. The URL is not returned in status or logs.
profileValidationTip: Uploads get basic name, size, and structure checks; the proxy core validates them before switching, and a running service is restarted.
importFieldsRequired: Enter an HTTPS URL and a configuration name ending in .yaml or .yml.
confirmSwitchRestart: Switching configuration restarts the running service. Continue?
ipCheckFailed: All egress IP services are unavailable.
